name: Pairlock
summary: A three-step two-factor setup: scan a pixel code, enter the app code, print backup codes
about: A complete two-step sign-in setup card in indigo and electric lime. A pixel code assembles itself under a scanning beam, a mock authenticator shows a 6-digit code that changes every 30 seconds, and once it matches you get eight backup codes that scramble into place with copy and download buttons. It ends on a shield that draws itself, with confetti.
how: Press I've scanned it, or copy the text key if you cannot scan
Type, paste or autofill the code shown in the app card; backspace and arrows move between boxes
The ring counts down 30 seconds and the code rolls over; the previous code still works for a moment
A matching code pairs the phone and prints eight backup codes you can copy or download as a text file
Press I've saved them to see the shield finish, or Start over for a new key
